title: site: coin Deterministic State — thesis post in five locales and a homepage band
context:
"Agents are probabilistic. Organizations need deterministic state." The category is
named Deterministic State. A pinned blog post explains it in plain words (drawers and
keys), says exactly what shipped in 1.25 and 1.26, names Sofia as the first agent on
it, and states what is still unproven. Translated titles, deks, key ideas and takeaways
in Hebrew, Russian, Arabic and Spanish; one URL per locale in the sitemap. A thin band
above the homepage navigation carries the thesis and links to the post
decision: Changed code in site/blog, tooling/blog-locales.mjs, tooling/generate-site-locales.mjs (4 file(s)).
